items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: I know I was with Giles. Oh, he used to play with the excelsior band.

ctx.x: He used a wire beater. Yeah. Did you see anybody when you were a boy, did they use the two cymbals, so they have two cymbals coming together up there?
Yeah, you know who that was? Clay Giles. Clay Giles.
You heard him talk about that.
